site.name: WaxWingFPV
site.title: WaxWingFPV | FPV drone filming for cafés and restaurants in Istanbul
site.tagline: Cinematic FPV video for Istanbul's cafés, restaurants and shops.
site.description: Cinematic FPV drone filming for cafés, restaurants and local businesses in Istanbul. Flights are conducted by a licensed pilot in compliance with Turkish SHGM regulations.
site.ogAlt: WaxwingFPV. An FPV pass over an Istanbul street, with The Nish Coffee signage visible on the left.

work.heading: Work
work.intro: Every job is delivered as two cuts of the same shoot: a horizontal film and a vertical reel.

kit.heading: The kit
kit.intro: Two aircraft and a camera. What each one is good at, and what it isn't.

services.heading: Services
services.intro: They all start the same way: nothing flies until I've seen the space.

process.heading: Process
process.intro: Five steps, start to finish. Each one says what it needs from you.

trust.heading: Flights and permissions
trust.built: The 5-inch wasn't bought assembled. Mario 5 frame, Mamba MK4 F722 stack, F40 V2 motors, built and tuned here.
trust.checklist: Every session starts with the same written preflight checklist.
trust.licenceBody: Flights are conducted by a licensed pilot in compliance with Turkish SHGM regulations.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.intro: Tell me about the space and what you want it to do. I reply within one working day.
contact.whatsappPrefill: Hi, I'd like to ask about FPV video for my venue.
